text:
Asking rents in Hamburg stand at a median of 15.47 €/m² (2026-06), up 5.1% on the year and +28.5% over five years. That ranks Hamburg #5 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 69% above the 2022 average contract rent of 9.16 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 928 € a month in cold rent, 18.8% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 23 days and 37% are gone within a week; with 1.0% market-active vacancy and +3.6% population growth over five years, the market looks tight.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 16.28 €/m² (+5.2%), with an 80% range of 15.91 to 16.67 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
